unlisted_practices: Define ML prediction tasks by the clinical decisions and interventions they enable within a given time horizon, rather than defaulting to rarely actionable outcomes such as in-hospital mortality or length of stay.
Harmonize units, ontologies, and timestamps, and use methods that handle incomplete records or missing modalities, when integrating multimodal clinical data for ML.
Choose the multimodal fusion strategy (early, intermediate, or late) deliberately according to the prediction task, data volume, computational resources, and deployment needs.
Use late fusion for first production pilots and real-time deployment where data modalities arrive asynchronously or may be missing.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article discussing multimodal clinical data fusion strategies (early, intermediate, late) and challenges in anesthesiology and intensive care.
